DesiredGainR: Auditable Multi-trait Selection Indices

Source: R/package-doc.R
DesiredGainR-package.Rd

Package providing tools for:

  • desired-gain selection index optimization,

  • quadratic genomic selection index computation from trait genomic estimated breeding values, explicit economic weights, genomic covariance estimation, and published response diagnostics,

  • comparison of DG and QGSI outputs,

  • a high-level wrapper for full pipeline execution.
